title: OR-01 · Retrieval and similarity matching
summary: Rank source observations for a query under a declared representation, geometry and relevance definition.

goals.title: Define the operation contract
goals.description: Define queries, searchable populations, relevance, source references, metric, ranking output and abstention conditions.

milestones.title: Specify inputs, outputs and requirements
milestones.description: Define queries, searchable populations, relevance, source references, metric, ranking output and abstention conditions. Create the Operation Contract and linked Requirements-and-Evidence Record before an experiment is admitted. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: The versioned Operation Contract and linked Requirements-and-Evidence Record specify input/output roles, claim scope, operation parameters, and typed failure or abstention conditions; existing charter links are design references, not evidence that this milestone is complete.

The contract inherits foundations-record-validation, foundations-temporal-integrity, foundations-data-protocol and foundations-lifecycle-admission. Any not-applicable rule is justified; a reusable interface can be drafted before instance selection, but an admitted run binds every required dataset, provider, artifact and protocol dependency.

Declare a frozen candidate-corpus snapshot, query eligibility and as-of policy, an independently defined relevance target, allowed query/document role pairs, and exclusions for self-matches, duplicates and source-window overlap where required by the evaluation design.

goals.title: Provide a reference implementation
goals.description: Provide version-aware search with explicit index configuration, source identities, exclusion rules and failure reporting.

milestones.title: Implement the agreed operation interface
milestones.description: Provide version-aware search with explicit index configuration, source identities, exclusion rules and failure reporting. The method, dataset and implementation slice remain to be selected. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: Conformance tests exercise the declared role/SpaceRef relationship, applicable temporal checks, malformed or unsupported inputs, stale fitted artifacts and explicit failure propagation; no rejected record becomes an ordinary vector or unreported omission.

Outputs retain parent/source lineage, representation kind, OperationRun identity, code/configuration and fitted-artifact identities. Engineering fixtures are labeled engineering-only and do not establish operation quality.

Use an exact-search reference with explicit metric, normalization, deterministic tie handling and source IDs before judging an approximate index. Reject stale or incompatible index/query combinations; a legitimate empty result remains distinct from execution failure.

goals.title: Establish operation-specific evidence
goals.description: Evaluate relevance and cost against meaningful retrieval baselines; control duplicates, leakage, population and representation version.

milestones.title: Define and execute the admitted evaluation
milestones.description: Evaluate relevance and cost against meaningful retrieval baselines; control duplicates, leakage, population and representation version. Freeze the selected protocol, baselines and failure criteria before held-out assessment; retain negative outcomes and limitations. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: The admitted protocol fixes data partitions, instance and artifact identities, baselines, budgets, selection policy, metrics and failure criteria before held-out assessment. Diagnostic exposure, changes and repeated looks are indexed; a revised protocol does not silently reuse an exposed confirmation set.

Report the declared evaluation unit, uncertainty or its justified limitation, coverage including abstentions and failures, and relevant resource costs. Index every initiated run and its outcome under foundations-evidence-ledger; do not discard unsuccessful or inconclusive evidence.

A valid completed evaluation can be negative or inconclusive. Milestone completion is not a positive claim verdict, and invalid or unexecuted attempts alone cannot satisfy operation-quality evaluation acceptance.

Measure relevance against independent labels or a declared external rule, not the embedding distance used to rank candidates. Assess approximate-neighbor fidelity separately from application relevance; preserve the same eligible corpus, input information and query population for baselines.

goals.title: Expose Hx01 capabilities as a reusable toolset
goals.description: Expose this Hero's developed components, validation, workflows and results through a consistent discover/configure/check/run/inspect command-line interface and reusable APIs across compatible representation providers. Cover retrieval configuration, query and corpus validation, search, ranking and result inspection; preserve operation-specific contracts and evidence limits as capabilities are selected and developed.

milestones.title: Define the public toolset surface and coverage
milestones.description: Map query/corpus admission, index construction and compatibility checks, exact or selected approximate search, ranking, exclusions and result/evidence inspection into public components and workflows.
acceptance: Inventory implemented and selected future public capabilities, their owning components, contracts, request/result schemas, reusable APIs, composition points, gaps and claim levels; distinguish available tools from proposed work.

The surface specifies query/document roles, frozen corpus and index identities, geometry, normalization, deterministic tie behavior, source IDs and self-match or overlap exclusions; empty results, abstention and execution failure remain distinct.

Specify discover/configure/check/run/inspect behavior across compatible representation providers, declaring required roles, SpaceRefs, geometry and dependencies without assuming a universal vector shape or provider suitability.

milestones.title: Expose and verify the agreed tools and workflows
milestones.description: Expose the agreed building blocks and composed workflows through the common command-line and reusable API boundary, keeping operation logic with its owning component and retaining inspectable results.
acceptance: Verify the agreed query-to-ranked-source workflow and independently callable components, including stale or incompatible index rejection, exclusion rules and deterministic ranking behavior. Approximate-search fidelity and independently measured application relevance retain separate evidence claims.

CLI and reusable API examples and conformance checks cover compatible provider interchange and explicit incompatibility, malformed input, failure and abstention; retain source/parent lineage, configuration, fitted-artifact identities and complete outcome accounting.

Record implemented coverage, remaining gaps and evidence for each agreed public capability and composed workflow. Reusable engineering checks do not authorize paused research or establish operation quality; new experimental claims retain their own admitted contracts, protocols and permissions.
